Name: Target Size
Description: Specifies the export resolution for Unity terrain heightmaps and textures. Select from standard Unity-compatible sizes to ensure proper import and terrain fidelity.

Flubs.Name: x8193
Flubs.Description: Exports at 8193 x 8193 pixels, suitable for very large Unity terrains requiring maximum detail.

Flubs.Name: x4097
Flubs.Description: Exports at 4097 x 4097 pixels, commonly used for large terrain tiles in Unity.

Flubs.Name: x2049
Flubs.Description: Exports at 2049 x 2049 pixels, ideal for medium-sized Unity terrain tiles.

Flubs.Name: x1025
Flubs.Description: Exports at 1025 x 1025 pixels, suitable for smaller terrain tiles or test scenes in Unity.

Flubs.Name: x513
Flubs.Description: Exports at 513 x 513 pixels, used for small terrain tiles or prototyping in Unity.

Name: Add Input
Description: Adds an additional input map layer for export, allowing for more complex terrain data to be sent to Unity.
